scenarios.scenario: Profile page displays the logged-in user's name, email address, and avatar image.
When the user has no avatar, the profile page shows a default placeholder icon.
Unauthenticated user is prevented from accessing the profile page.
If the profile data fails to load, an error message is displayed to the user.

test_data_env.test_data: User with name, email, avatar; User without avatar
test_data_env.environment: Not specified in ticket — see G-5

assumptions: Unauthenticated users cannot view the profile page
Error handling displays a generic error message
Performance measured under standard network conditions
